findings.verdict: T3 is SOUND but (i) two statements in drain_lemma.md v2 are wrong/vacuous as printed, (ii) interval Krawczyk on FJ(S) is inoperative without multiplier information, and (iii) as a cover of the 33-dim configuration space the cost is c^33 per critical point with c ~ 1.86 measured and SCALE-INVARIANT, i.e. refinement never reduces the number of undischarged cells. The per-branch engine is cheap: 0.2 s for a 69-variable FJ Krawczyk.

draft_corrections.C1_FJ_sign: v2 prints 'lambda_0 grad s + sum lambda_k grad g_k = 0' but writes its constraints g_k >= 0. The correct row is lambda_0 grad s - sum lambda_k grad g_k = 0 (= A22's A_S^T lambda = e_s). With the printed sign the uniform-expansion direction is a Farkas certificate at EVERY configuration, so T3(c) would exclude every cell and prove anything. BLOCKING.
draft_corrections.C2_D2_vacuous: D2 demands 'every bounding-box clearance >= delta'; sigma is the side of the MINIMAL enclosing square, so some corner always has clearance exactly 0 and the hypothesis never holds. Repair: shrink about the container centre m = (sigma/2, sigma/2) with eta = delta/(2 sqrt2 sigma). Relative centre displacement <= delta/2 so all gaps stay positive; the owner of the max-x corner has c_x >= sigma - sqrt2/2 > sigma/2 and the owner of the min-x corner has c_x < sigma/2 whenever sigma > sqrt2 (here sigma >= 3), so both extents strictly decrease. D2 then needs ONLY the pairwise gaps. Implemented in t3lib.test_ab.
draft_corrections.C3_sep_row_sign: D3'(ii) prints '(c_j - c_i).u >= h_i + (corner_k* - c_j).u'; the correct row is '(corner_k*(j) - c_i).u >= 1/2' (minus sign on the second term). Implemented as A22's.

gordan_test.statement: With the corrected sign, a single y in R^34 with grad s . y < 0 and grad g_k(z).y > 0 for all z in C and all rows k that can be active on C forces lambda_0 = 0 AND all lambda_k = 0, contradicting the normalisation, so no FJ point of ANY menu selection lies in C.
gordan_test.sharpness: By Gordan's theorem the LP is infeasible IFF FJ multipliers exist for some gradient tuple in the interval hull: it is the exact first-order test, nothing gradient-only can beat it.
gordan_test.union_form_blocked_by_flush_ties: At a flush contact the two tied dominant-corner selections are both in the menu and their tied dominance rows are exact negatives (verified: D-6-0-9-2-3 vs D-6-0-9-3-2), so no y can increase both; the union LP then returns eps = 0 identically.

findings.empty_menu_rule: If a straddling pair's 32-selection menu is EMPTY (every selection has a row certified < 0 on all of C) then by menu completeness no z in C has that pair interior-disjoint, so C n D_0 = empty. Strictly stronger than the naive interval-SAT test; fired on 5 of 28 P2 cells. Adversarially validated.

cell_count_model.bnb: delta_kill/h measured scale-invariant over a 50x range of h and two s0 values: min 1.15, median 1.86, max 3.75. Surviving cells per critical point ~ c^33 = 1.1e2 / 7.8e8 / 8.8e18, INDEPENDENT of h.
cell_count_model.endgame_shell: T3 cannot close alone (a minimiser exists at s0 >= s*); it must be composed with A22's local certificate (r_N = 5e-4). Refinement must reach 1.86h + h <= 5e-4, i.e. h <= 1.75e-4, and the shell then holds ~1.86^33 = 7.8e8 cells (x8 unreduced D4 copies).
cell_count_model.caveat: A floor, not an estimate: it counts only the shell around Trump and excludes the rest of D_0, the other 35 A04 local optima, and all C(42,34)-style active-set branches.

recommendations: Menu FACTORISATION: Cons(z) is a product over pairs, so 'exclude every selection' factorises into per-pair covering sets K_p; minimal K_p would cut P1's menu from 131072 to at most 2^8 = 256. Not implemented.

Branch on STRUCTURE (contact/selection graph) with the coordinate box held large, one square FJ system per structure solved globally (homotopy/Groebner) - removes the c^33 factor entirely, but needs a different solver.
Keep A24/A27's structure reduction at the top of the tree; T3-style FJ certificates only at the last level, inside boxes already reduced to h ~ 1e-4.
Re-emit rows in t = tan(theta/2) (A28's blocker): makes the FJ systems algebraic, enables the global solvers above, and unblocks the Lean re-checker.
gaps: G1 FJ stationarity sign in D3' is wrong for the draft's own g >= 0 convention (BLOCKING; see C1).
G2 D2 as printed is vacuous (see C2); the centroid repair needs advisor review.
G4 mpmath.iv trusted (same gap as A22); dps 30 here vs A22's 65.
G5 angle parametrisation, not t = tan(theta/2): rows are transcendental, so nothing here is a polynomial certificate and none of it is Lean-portable.
G6 the FJ Jacobian needs constraint Hessians, supplied by an interval forward-AD jet validated only indirectly (via the A22 isolation cross-check).
G7 Krawczyk preconditioner Y = float64 inverse of the midpoint Jacobian; sound but unoptimised.
G8 naive interval extension (no centred/mean-value form) over-reports 'straddles activity': every menu size quoted here is an OVER-estimate by an unmeasured factor.
G9 menu completeness is argued, not machine-checked (only adversarial sampling supports it).
G10 the union-Farkas test is conservative; its failures do not imply per-selection (c1) fails.
G11 the D4 x S11 symmetry reduction is NOT implemented; all counts are for the unreduced space.
G12 c = delta_kill/h is measured along 24 directions from ONE critical point with only (a)/(b)/(c1-union); no root-level B&B dive was run, so the cost of the non-critical part of D_0 is unmeasured.
G13 P3's 'generic' configuration is the loosest member of A04's 5x45 family, not a random point of D_0.
G14 P1 exhibits ONE |A| = 34 active-set vertex; a sound (c2) must enumerate all subsets.
G15 no certificate file format and no independent re-checker; Farkas directions are verified in-process only.
G16 clip_s lower-bounds s with the naive interval max_corner; a tighter sigma enclosure would strengthen (a).
findings.p1: Cell of radius 5e-4 at Trump, s0 = shat + 1e-6: 20 wall rows + 14 straddling pairs, MENU = 131072 = 4^7 x 8 (16384 of them already consistent at zhat itself), union of possibly-active rows = 98. NOT excluded by any test, which is correct since zhat is a minimiser. Full per-selection sweep 131072/131072, 0 killed, 239 CPU-s / 42 s wall on 6 workers. Gradient rank 34 of 42 rows, so the multiplier polytope is 8-DIMENSIONAL and all 42 rows carry lambda >= 0.0476: the complementarity-form Jacobian is exactly singular in 12/12 sampled selections. The active-set sub-branch (|A| = 34 vertex, min lambda = 0.017542, matching A22's 0.01754) gives n = 69, cond 69, and ISOLATES at h <= 2.4e-4 (ratio 0.9997 at 2e-4, 1.0132 at 5e-4) in 0.20 s - about half A22's r_N. The lambda_0 = 0 branch is present in 2/12 sampled selections.
findings.p2: 10x-radius offsets, re-normalised so the min corner sits at the origin. At s0 = shat + 1e-6, 14/14 cells are discharged by (a) alone, consistent with A22's 155.7 Lipschitz bound. At s0 = shat + 1e-2: 11 by (a), 2 by (a-menu), 1 alive. Expansion scan at s0 = shat + 0.2: eta >= 0.01 gives (b) D2 (min gap +0.0035..+0.0334); eta = 0.0026 and 0.005 stay alive with exactly 1/8 of the menu (1024/8192 and 128/1024) surviving the per-selection Farkas test.
findings.p3: Loosest 5x45 family configuration expanded to s = 3.9 (eta = 0.00429, min gap 0.00388), perturbed by +-5e-4, s0 = 3.9. h = 0.01: 18 straddling pairs, MENU 4.03e8, union 140 rows, 60000 selections tested, 0 killed. h = 0.001: menu 32768, complete sweep, 18432 killed / 14336 alive (44%). h <= 3e-4: (b) D2 fires. Multiplier polytope dimension 15-16; lambda_0 = 0 branch in 5/8 sampled selections. D2 reach is h_D2 ~ 0.015 (s0 - s*): 2e-4 at 3.90, 1e-3 at 3.95, 2e-3 at 4.00, 5e-3 at 4.20, so AT s0 = s* the D2 reach is ZERO and the whole burden falls on (a) and (c).
findings.c2_honest: Krawczyk with lambda over the whole simplex box [0,1]^(m+1) - what T3(c) literally asks - gives 0/30 excluded, 0/30 isolated, 20/30 singular, across P1 and two P3 cells. The cheap '0 not in F(N)' range test also excludes 0/30. Sound repairs: subdivide the lambda simplex (an extra m-dimensional B&B per selection), or enumerate active sets (C(42,34) = 1.2e8 for P1 and C(49,34) = 1.4e12 for P3, PER SELECTION).
